"""Functions to run the TERPSICHORE stability solver on a DESC equilibrium."""

import datetime
import functools
import multiprocessing as mp
import os
import shutil
import subprocess

import numpy as np
from netCDF4 import Dataset, stringtochar

from desc.backend import jnp
from desc.basis import DoubleFourierSeries
from desc.compat import flip_theta
from desc.compute.utils import get_transforms
from desc.grid import LinearGrid
from desc.objectives import ExternalObjective
from desc.objectives.objective_funs import collect_docs
from desc.transform import Transform
from desc.utils import errorif, warnif
from desc.vmec_utils import ptolemy_identity_rev, zernike_to_fourier


def terpsichore(
    eq,
    *,
    processes=1,
    path,
    exec,
    mode_family=-1,
    surfs=101,
    M_nyq=None,
    N_nyq=None,
    M_booz_max=None,
    N_booz_max=None,
    M_max=8,
    N_min=-4,
    N_max=4,
    lssl=None,
    lssd=None,
    awall=2.0,
    deltaJp=1e-4,
    modelk=0,
    al0=-5e-1,
    timeout=60,
    tmp_dir="tmp_TERPS",
    save_tmp=False,
    data_transforms=None,
    fit_transform=None,
    theta0_outboard=True,
):
    """TERPSICHORE driver function.

    Parameters
    ----------
    eq : list
        A list of Equilibrium objects to run TERPSICHORE on.
    processes : int, optional
        Maximum number of CPU threads to use for multiprocessing. Default = 1.
    path : str
        Path to the directory where temporary files will be stored.
    exec : str
        File name of the TERPSICHORE executable. Must be located in the directory
        specified by ``path``.
    mode_family : int, optional
        The mode family of the instabilities to consider. The toroidal modes included
        in a mode family are n_i = i * eq.NFP ± k, where i = ..., -1, 0, +1, ... and
        k ∈ [0, mode_family]. Possible mode families are in the range [0, eq.NFP // 2].
        If mode_family < 0 then all mode families are considered. Default = -1.
    surfs : int, optional
        Number of surfaces to include in the equilibrium input. More surfaces provides
        more accuracy at the cost of longer compute times. Default = 101.
    M_nyq, N_nyq: int
        The max poloidal and toroidal mode numbers to use in the Nyquist spectrum of the
        equilibrium input. Defaults to ``eq.M + 4`` and ``eq.N + 2``.
    M_booz_max, N_booz_max : int, optional
        Maximum poloidal and toroidal mode numbers of Boozer spectrum. Will include
        modes with m ∈ [0, M_booz_max] and n ∈ [-N_booz_max, N_booz_max].
        Defaults to ``2 * eq.M`` and ``2 * eq.N``.
    M_max : int, optional
        Maximum poloidal mode number of stability modes to consider. Will include modes
        with m ∈ [0, M_max] (if ``mode_family < 0``). Default = 8.
    N_min : int, optional
        Minimum toroidal mode number of stability modes to consider. Will include modes
        with n ∈ [N_min, N_max] (if ``mode_family < 0``). Default = -4.
    N_max : int, optional
        Maximum toroidal mode number of stability modes to consider. Will include modes
        with n ∈ [N_min, N_max] (if ``mode_family < 0``). Default = 4.
    lssl : int, optional
        Minimum number of possible permutations of Boozer mode combinations
        (determined by ``M_booz_max`` and ``N_booz_max``). If TERPSICHORE fails to run,
        try increasing this parameter. Default = ``20 * M_booz_max * N_booz_max``.
    lssd : int, optional
        Minimum number of possible permutations of stability mode combinations
        (determined by ``M_max`` and ``N_max``). If TERPSICHORE fails to run,
        try increasing this parameter. Default = ``20 * M_max * N_max``.
    awall : float, optional
        Ratio of the radius of the conformal conducting wall to the plasma minor radius.
        The conducting wall is obtained by scaling the m ≠ 0 Fourier components of the
        plasma boundary by ``awall``. A shorter wall offset will help stabilize the
        plasma. If TERPSICHORE fails to run, try decreasing this parameter. Default = 2.
    deltaJp : float
        Resonance detuning parameter to resolve parallel current density singularities.
        A larger value can artificially improve the stability. Default = 1e-4.
    modelk : int, optional
        0 = Noninteracting anisotropic fast particle stability model with reduced
        kinetic energy. 1 = Kruskal-Oberman anisotropic energy principle model with
        reduced kinetic energy. 2 = Noninteracting anisotropic fast particle stability
        model with physical kinetic energy. 3 = Kruskal-Oberman anisotropic energy
        principle model with physical kinetic energy. Default = 0.
    al0 : float, optional
        Initial guess of the eigenvalue. Use a sufficiently negative value to find the
        most unstable growth rate. If TERPSICHORE fails to run, the objective will
        return a growth rate of ``abs(al0)``. Default = -0.5.
    timeout : float, optional
        Time in seconds to wait for TERPSICHORE to execute before terminating its run.
        See ``timeout`` argument of ``subprocess.run`` for more info. Default = 60.
    tmp_dir : str, optional
        Name of directory where temporary files used and generated by TERPSICHORE are
        stored. This will be a sub-directory within the directory specified by ``path``.
        Default = "tmp_TERPS".
    save_tmp : bool, optional
        If True, ``tmp_dir`` is preserved to record the TERPSICHORE I/O files.
        It will contain sub-directories named by a timestamp for each time the function
        was evaluated. Those contain another layer of sub-directories named by integers
        ranging from 0 to ``len(eq)`` with the files used in each TERPSICHORE call.
        If False, ``tmp_dir`` and all of its contents are removed at the end of the
        function evaluation. Default = False.
    data_transforms, fit_transform : dict, Transform
        Transform objects used for writing the wout files.
    theta0_outboard : bool
        Should be True if theta=0 is defined at the outboard midplane and False
        otherwise. TERPSICHORE assumes theta=0 is on the outboard midplane, and so the
        equilibria will be flipped correspondingly if this is not already the case.

    Returns
    -------
    result : ndarray
        The TERPSICHORE linear growth rate of the fastest growing instability,
        normalized by the Alfven frequency. A negative growth rate denotes stability and
        a positive growth rate denotes instability. If TERPSICHORE fails to run, a
        result of ``abs(al0)`` is returned.

    """
    # TERPSICHORE assumes theta=0 is on the outboard midplane
    if not theta0_outboard:
        eq = flip_theta(eq)

    # create a temporary directory to store I/O files
    tmp_path = os.path.join(path, tmp_dir)
    if not os.path.exists(tmp_path):
        os.mkdir(tmp_path)  # tmp_path = highest-level directory for all temporary files
    timestamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")
    time_path = os.path.join(tmp_path, timestamp)
    os.mkdir(time_path)  # time_path = sub-dir for each time this function is called

    # write input files for each equilibrium in serial
    idxs = list(range(len(eq)))  # equilibrium indices
    for k in idxs:
        idx_path = os.path.join(time_path, str(k))
        os.mkdir(idx_path)  # idx_path = sub-sub-dir for each eq in the list of eqs
        exec_path = os.path.join(idx_path, exec)
        input_path = os.path.join(idx_path, "input")
        wout_path = os.path.join(idx_path, "wout.nc")
        shutil.copy(os.path.join(path, exec), exec_path)
        _write_wout(
            eq=eq[k],
            path=wout_path,
            surfs=surfs,
            M_nyq=M_nyq,
            N_nyq=N_nyq,
            data_transforms=data_transforms,
            fit_transform=fit_transform,
        )
        _write_terps_input(
            path=input_path,
            mode_family=mode_family,
            surfs=surfs,
            M_booz_max=2 * eq[k].M if M_booz_max is None else M_booz_max,
            N_booz_max=2 * eq[k].N if N_booz_max is None else N_booz_max,
            M_max=M_max,
            N_min=N_min,
            N_max=N_max,
            lssl=lssl,
            lssd=lssd,
            awall=awall,
            deltaJp=deltaJp,
            modelk=modelk,
            nfp=eq[k].NFP,
            al0=al0,
        )

    # run TERPSICHORE on list of equilibria in parallel
    if len(eq) == 1:  # no multiprocessing if only one equilibrium
        result = jnp.atleast_1d(
            _pool_fun(0, path=time_path, exec=exec, al0=al0, timeout=timeout)
        )
    else:
        with mp.Pool(processes=min(processes, len(eq))) as pool:
            results = pool.map(
                functools.partial(
                    _pool_fun, path=time_path, exec=exec, al0=al0, timeout=timeout
                ),
                idxs,
            )
            result = jnp.vstack(results, dtype=float)

    # remove temporary directory and all sub-directories
    if not save_tmp:
        shutil.rmtree(tmp_path)

    return result


def _write_wout(
    eq, path, surfs, M_nyq, N_nyq, data_transforms, fit_transform
):  # noqa: C901
    """Write the wout NetCDF file from the equilibrium."""
    # this is a lightweight version of VMECIO.save
    file = Dataset(path, mode="w", format="NETCDF3_64BIT_OFFSET")

    Psi = eq.Psi
    NFP = eq.NFP
    M = eq.M
    N = eq.N
    M_nyq = M + 4 if M_nyq is None else M_nyq
    N_nyq = N + 2 if N_nyq is None else N_nyq
    N_nyq = 0 if int(N) == 0 else N_nyq
    M_grid = eq.M_grid
    N_grid = eq.N_grid

    # VMEC radial coordinate: s = rho^2 = Psi / Psi(LCFS)
    s_full = np.linspace(0, 1, surfs)
    s_half = s_full[0:-1] + 0.5 / (surfs - 1)
    r_full = np.sqrt(s_full)
    r_half = np.sqrt(s_half)

    # dimensions
    file.createDimension("radius", surfs)  # number of flux surfaces
    file.createDimension("mn_mode", (2 * N + 1) * M + N + 1)  # number of Fourier modes
    file.createDimension(
        "mn_mode_nyq", (2 * N_nyq + 1) * M_nyq + N_nyq + 1
    )  # number of Nyquist Fourier modes
    file.createDimension("n_tor", N + 1)  # number of toroidal Fourier modes
    file.createDimension("preset", 21)  # dimension of profile inputs
    file.createDimension("ndfmax", 101)  # used for am_aux & ai_aux
    file.createDimension("time", 100)  # used for fsq* & wdot
    file.createDimension("dim_00001", 1)
    file.createDimension("dim_00020", 20)
    file.createDimension("dim_00100", 100)
    file.createDimension("dim_00200", 200)

    grid_half = LinearGrid(M=M_grid, N=N_grid, NFP=NFP, rho=r_half)
    data_half = eq.compute(
        [
            "B_rho",
            "B_theta",
            "B_zeta",
            "G",
            "I",
            "J",
            "iota",
            "p",
            "sqrt(g)",
            "V_r(r)",
            "|B|",
            "<|B|^2>",
        ],
        grid=grid_half,
        transforms=data_transforms,
    )

    mgrid_file = file.createVariable("mgrid_file", "S1", ("dim_00200",))
    mgrid_file[:] = stringtochar(
        np.array(["none" + " " * 196], "S" + str(file.dimensions["dim_00200"].size))
    )

    lasym = file.createVariable("lasym__logical__", np.int32)
    lasym.long_name = "asymmetry logical (0 = stellarator symmetry)"
    lasym[:] = int(not eq.sym)

    nfp = file.createVariable("nfp", np.int32)
    nfp.long_name = "number of field periods"
    nfp[:] = NFP

    ns = file.createVariable("ns", np.int32)
    ns.long_name = "number of flux surfaces"
    ns[:] = surfs

    mpol = file.createVariable("mpol", np.int32)
    mpol.long_name = "number of poloidal Fourier modes"
    mpol[:] = M + 1

    ntor = file.createVariable("ntor", np.int32)
    ntor.long_name = "number of positive toroidal Fourier modes"
    ntor[:] = N

    mnmax = file.createVariable("mnmax", np.int32)
    mnmax.long_name = "total number of Fourier modes"
    mnmax[:] = file.dimensions["mn_mode"].size

    xm = file.createVariable("xm", np.float64, ("mn_mode",))
    xm.long_name = "poloidal mode numbers"
    xm[:] = np.tile(np.linspace(0, M, M + 1), (2 * N + 1, 1)).T.flatten()[
        -file.dimensions["mn_mode"].size :
    ]

    xn = file.createVariable("xn", np.float64, ("mn_mode",))
    xn.long_name = "toroidal mode numbers"
    xn[:] = np.tile(np.linspace(-N, N, 2 * N + 1) * NFP, M + 1)[
        -file.dimensions["mn_mode"].size :
    ]

    mnmax_nyq = file.createVariable("mnmax_nyq", np.int32)
    mnmax_nyq.long_name = "total number of Nyquist Fourier modes"
    mnmax_nyq[:] = file.dimensions["mn_mode_nyq"].size

    xm_nyq = file.createVariable("xm_nyq", np.float64, ("mn_mode_nyq",))
    xm_nyq.long_name = "poloidal Nyquist mode numbers"
    xm_nyq[:] = np.tile(
        np.linspace(0, M_nyq, M_nyq + 1), (2 * N_nyq + 1, 1)
    ).T.flatten()[-file.dimensions["mn_mode_nyq"].size :]

    xn_nyq = file.createVariable("xn_nyq", np.float64, ("mn_mode_nyq",))
    xn_nyq.long_name = "toroidal Nyquist mode numbers"
    xn_nyq[:] = np.tile(np.linspace(-N_nyq, N_nyq, 2 * N_nyq + 1) * NFP, M_nyq + 1)[
        -file.dimensions["mn_mode_nyq"].size :
    ]

    gamma = file.createVariable("gamma", np.float64)
    gamma.long_name = "compressibility index (0 = pressure prescribed)"
    gamma[:] = 0

    # half mesh quantities

    pres = file.createVariable("pres", np.float64, ("radius",))
    pres.long_name = "pressure on half mesh"
    pres.units = "Pa"
    pres[0] = 0
    pres[1:] = grid_half.compress(data_half["p"])

    mass = file.createVariable("mass", np.float64, ("radius",))
    mass.long_name = "mass on half mesh"
    mass.units = "Pa"
    mass[:] = pres[:]

    iotas = file.createVariable("iotas", np.float64, ("radius",))
    iotas.long_name = "rotational transform on half mesh"
    iotas.units = "None"
    iotas[0] = 0
    iotas[1:] = -grid_half.compress(data_half["iota"])  # - for negative Jacobian

    phips = file.createVariable("phips", np.float64, ("radius",))
    phips.long_name = "d(phi)/ds * -1/2pi: toroidal flux derivative, on half mesh"
    phips[0] = 0
    phips[1:] = -Psi * np.ones((surfs - 1,)) / (2 * np.pi)

    vp = file.createVariable("vp", np.float64, ("radius",))
    vp.long_name = "dV/ds normalized by 4*pi^2, on half mesh"
    vp.units = "m^3"
    vp[1:] = grid_half.compress(data_half["V_r(r)"]) / (
        8 * np.pi**2 * grid_half.compress(data_half["rho"])
    )
    vp[0] = 0

    # R
    rmnc = file.createVariable("rmnc", np.float64, ("radius", "mn_mode"))
    rmnc.long_name = "cos(m*t-n*p) component of cylindrical R, on full mesh"
    rmnc.units = "m"
    if not eq.sym:
        rmns = file.createVariable("rmns", np.float64, ("radius", "mn_mode"))
        rmns.long_name = "sin(m*t-n*p) component of cylindrical R, on full mesh"
        rmns.units = "m"
    r1 = np.ones_like(eq.R_lmn)
    r1[eq.R_basis.modes[:, 1] < 0] *= -1
    m, n, x_mn = zernike_to_fourier(r1 * eq.R_lmn, basis=eq.R_basis, rho=r_full)
    xm, xn, s, c = ptolemy_identity_rev(m, n, x_mn)
    rmnc[:] = c
    if not eq.sym:
        rmns[:] = s

    # Z
    zmns = file.createVariable("zmns", np.float64, ("radius", "mn_mode"))
    zmns.long_name = "sin(m*t-n*p) component of cylindrical Z, on full mesh"
    zmns.units = "m"
    if not eq.sym:
        zmnc = file.createVariable("zmnc", np.float64, ("radius", "mn_mode"))
        zmnc.long_name = "cos(m*t-n*p) component of cylindrical Z, on full mesh"
        zmnc.units = "m"
    z1 = np.ones_like(eq.Z_lmn)
    z1[eq.Z_basis.modes[:, 1] < 0] *= -1
    m, n, x_mn = zernike_to_fourier(z1 * eq.Z_lmn, basis=eq.Z_basis, rho=r_full)
    xm, xn, s, c = ptolemy_identity_rev(m, n, x_mn)
    zmns[:] = s
    if not eq.sym:
        zmnc[:] = c

    # derived quantities (approximate conversion)

    def fit(x):
        y = fit_transform.fit(x)
        return np.where(fit_transform.basis.modes[:, 1] < 0, -y, y)

    # Jacobian
    gmnc = file.createVariable("gmnc", np.float64, ("radius", "mn_mode_nyq"))
    gmnc.long_name = "cos(m*t-n*p) component of Jacobian, on half mesh"
    gmnc.units = "m"
    if not eq.sym:
        gmns = file.createVariable("gmns", np.float64, ("radius", "mn_mode_nyq"))
        gmns.long_name = "sin(m*t-n*p) component of Jacobian, on half mesh"
        gmns.units = "m"
    m = fit_transform.basis.modes[:, 1]
    n = fit_transform.basis.modes[:, 2]
    # d(rho)/d(s) = 1/(2*rho)
    data = (
        (data_half["sqrt(g)"] / (2 * data_half["rho"]))
        .reshape(
            (grid_half.num_theta, grid_half.num_rho, grid_half.num_zeta), order="F"
        )
        .transpose((1, 0, 2))
        .reshape((grid_half.num_rho, -1), order="F")
    )
    x_mn = np.zeros((surfs - 1, m.size))
    for i in range(surfs - 1):
        x_mn[i, :] = fit(data[i, :])
    xm, xn, s, c = ptolemy_identity_rev(m, n, x_mn)
    gmnc[0, :] = 0
    gmnc[1:, :] = -c  # negative sign for negative Jacobian
    if not eq.sym:
        gmns[0, :] = 0
        gmns[1:, :] = -s

    # |B|
    bmnc = file.createVariable("bmnc", np.float64, ("radius", "mn_mode_nyq"))
    bmnc.long_name = "cos(m*t-n*p) component of |B|, on half mesh"
    bmnc.units = "T"
    if not eq.sym:
        bmns = file.createVariable("bmns", np.float64, ("radius", "mn_mode_nyq"))
        bmns.long_name = "sin(m*t-n*p) component of |B|, on half mesh"
        bmns.units = "T"
    m = fit_transform.basis.modes[:, 1]
    n = fit_transform.basis.modes[:, 2]
    data = (
        data_half["|B|"]
        .reshape(
            (grid_half.num_theta, grid_half.num_rho, grid_half.num_zeta), order="F"
        )
        .transpose((1, 0, 2))
        .reshape((grid_half.num_rho, -1), order="F")
    )
    x_mn = np.zeros((surfs - 1, m.size))
    for i in range(surfs - 1):
        x_mn[i, :] = fit(data[i, :])
    xm, xn, s, c = ptolemy_identity_rev(m, n, x_mn)
    bmnc[0, :] = 0
    bmnc[1:, :] = c
    if not eq.sym:
        bmns[0, :] = 0
        bmns[1:, :] = s

    file.close()


def _write_terps_input(  # noqa: C901
    path,
    mode_family,
    surfs,
    M_booz_max,
    N_booz_max,
    M_max,
    N_min,
    N_max,
    lssl,
    lssd,
    awall,
    deltaJp,
    modelk,
    nfp,
    al0,
):
    """Write TERPSICHORE input file."""
    lssl = 20 * M_booz_max * N_booz_max if lssl is None else lssl
    lssd = 20 * M_max * N_max if lssd is None else lssd

    ivac = surfs // 4
    if (N_max > 8) or (M_max > 16):
        nj = 150
        nk = 150
    elif (N_max > 4) or (M_max > 8):
        nj = 100
        nk = 100
    else:
        nj = 50
        nk = 50

    f = open(path, "w")

    f.write("               TERPSICHORE\n")
    f.write("C\n")

C----------------------------------------------------------------------C
C  20.07.88          LAST MODIFICATION 25.05.05   UHS: LHSMATM DATA D
C----------------------------------------------------------------------C
C
      subroutine LHSMAT(ni,ivac,lmns,llhspr,s,ftp,fpp,ftpp,fppp,ci,cj,
     &                  ql,ms,ns,c0,c1,c2,c3,c4,c5,c6,c9,a,b,c,d,e,f,
     &                  g,h,bl,bu,igreen)
C
C----------------------------------------------------------------------C
C     CALCULATE THE LHS MATRIX ELEMENTS
C----------------------------------------------------------------------C
C
C     THE BLOCK STRUCTURE OF THE LHS MATRIX
C
C    ___________________________________________________________
C   |                   |                   |                   |
C   |                   |                   |                   |
C   |                   |                   |                   |
C   |   B(LC,LR,I-1)    |    E(LC,LR,I)     |     C(LC,LR,I)    |
C   |                   |                   |                   |
C   |                   |                   |                   |
C   |                   |                   |                   |
C    ___________________________________________________________
C   |                   |                   |                   |
C   |                   |                   |                   |
C   |                   |                   |                   |
C   |    F(LC,LR,I)     |    D(LC,LR,I)     |     G(LC,LR,I)    |
C   |                   |                   |                   |
C   |                   |                   |                   |
C   |                   |                   |                   |
C    ___________________________________________________________
C   |                   |                   |                   |
C   |                   |                   |                   |
C   |                   |                   |                   |
C   |    A(LC,LR,I)     |    H(LC,LR,I)     |     B(LC,LR,I)    |
C   |                   |                   |                   |
C   |                   |                   |                   |
C   |                   |                   |                   |
C    ___________________________________________________________
C
C----------------------------------------------------------------------C
C
C
C.. Implicits ..
      USE tpr_param, ONLY: iunit_16
      implicit none
C
C.. Formal Arguments ..
      integer lmns,ni,ivac,llhspr,ms(*),ns(*),igreen
      real s(0:*),ftp(*),fpp(*),ftpp(*),fppp(*),ci(*),cj(*),ql(*),
     &     c0(lmns,lmns,*),c1(lmns,lmns,*),c2(lmns,lmns,*),
     &     c3(lmns,lmns,*),c4(lmns,lmns,*),c5(lmns,lmns,*),
     &     c6(lmns,lmns,*),c9(lmns,lmns,*),a(lmns,lmns,*),
     &     b(lmns,lmns,0:*),c(lmns,lmns,*),d(lmns,lmns,*),
     &     e(lmns,lmns,*),f(lmns,lmns,*),g(lmns,lmns,*),h(lmns,lmns,*),
     &     bl(lmns,lmns,*),bu(lmns,lmns,*)
C
C.. Local Scalars ..
      integer i,LC,LR,niv,npr,nprocs
      real CMN,DMN,dsvar,fppfpp,ftpfpp,ftpftp,GBTS,PMN,RMN,SI,SIIC,SIIR,
     &     SIIS,sim,sip,T1,T2,T2DS,T4,T5,TDSS,tdsvac,tdsvsq
C
C ... Executable Statements ...
C
C
C      DIMENSION SG(192), SB(192)
C      DIMENSION CT1(192),CT2(192),CT3(192),CT4(192),CT5(192)
C      DIMENSION CT6(192),CT7(192),CT8(192),CT9(192),CT0(192)
C
      npr = 1
      nprocs = 1
      niv = ni + ivac
      do i = npr,niv,nprocs
        T2DS = 2.0 / (s(i)-s(i-1))
        TDSS = T2DS * T2DS
        SI = 0.5 * (s(i)+s(i-1))
        dsvar = ni * (s(i)-s(i-1))
C
CPERF SCALE C0...C9 WITH DSTAN= 1./ (NPER/NSTA) * DS
C
CPERF DSTAN = 1. / (NPER/NSTA) * DS
C
        if (i .gt. ni) then
C
C     MATRIX ELEMENTS IN THE VACUUM REGION TREATED AS PSEUDOPLASMA.
C
C      sip = 1. + dsvac * (i - ni) / max0(ivac,1)
C      sim = 1. + dsvac * (i - ni - 1.)/max0(ivac,1)
C
          sip = s(i)
          sim = s(i-1)
          dsvar = ni * (sip-sim)
          tdsvac = 2. / (sip-sim)
          tdsvsq = tdsvac * tdsvac
          fppfpp = fpp(ni+1) * fpp(ni+1)
          ftpfpp = 2. * ftp(ni+1) * fpp(ni+1)
          ftpftp = ftp(ni+1) * ftp(ni+1)
          do lc = 1,lmns
            pmn = ms(lc)*fpp(ni+1) - ns(lc)*ftp(ni+1)
            do lr = lc,lmns
              rmn = ms(lr)*fpp(ni+1) - ns(lr)*ftp(ni+1)
              a(lc,lr,i) =
     &          tdsvsq *
     &          (fppfpp*c6(lc,lr,i)+ftpfpp*c2(lc,lr,i)+
     &           ftpftp*c1(lc,lr,i))
              f(lc,lr,i) =
     &          tdsvac * rmn *
     &          (fpp(ni+1)*c4(lc,lr,i)+ftp(ni+1)*c5(lc,lr,i))
              f(lr,lc,i) =
     &          tdsvac * pmn *
     &          (fpp(ni+1)*c4(lr,lc,i)+ftp(ni+1)*c5(lr,lc,i))
              h(lc,lr,i) = pmn * rmn * c3(lc,lr,i)
              bu(lc,lr,i) =
     &          0.25 * (a(lc,lr,i)+f(lc,lr,i)+f(lr,lc,i)+h(lc,lr,i)) *
     &          dsvar
              bl(lc,lr,i) =
     &          0.25 * (a(lc,lr,i)-f(lc,lr,i)-f(lr,lc,i)+h(lc,lr,i)) *
     &          dsvar
              c(lc,lr,i) =
     &          0.25 * (-a(lc,lr,i)+f(lc,lr,i)-f(lr,lc,i)+h(lc,lr,i)) *
     &          dsvar
              c(lr,lc,i) =
     &          0.25 * (-a(lc,lr,i)-f(lc,lr,i)+f(lr,lc,i)+h(lc,lr,i)) *
     &          dsvar
              f(lc,lr,i) =
     &          tdsvac *
     &          (ms(lr)*(fpp(ni+1)*c2(lc,lr,i)+ftp(ni+1)*c1(lc,lr,i))+
     &           ns(lr)*(fpp(ni+1)*c6(lc,lr,i)+ftp(ni+1)*c2(lc,lr,i)))
              f(lr,lc,i) =
     &          tdsvac *
     &          (ms(lc)*(fpp(ni+1)*c2(lc,lr,i)+ftp(ni+1)*c1(lc,lr,i))+
     &           ns(lc)*(fpp(ni+1)*c6(lc,lr,i)+ftp(ni+1)*c2(lc,lr,i)))
              h(lc,lr,i) = pmn * (ms(lr)*c5(lr,lc,i)+ns(lr)*c4(lr,lc,i))
              h(lr,lc,i) = rmn * (ms(lc)*c5(lc,lr,i)+ns(lc)*c4(lc,lr,i))
              e(lc,lr,i) = 0.5 * (f(lc,lr,i)+h(lc,lr,i)) * dsvar
              e(lr,lc,i) = 0.5 * (f(lr,lc,i)+h(lr,lc,i)) * dsvar
              g(lc,lr,i) = 0.5 * (-f(lr,lc,i)+h(lr,lc,i)) * dsvar
              g(lr,lc,i) = 0.5 * (-f(lc,lr,i)+h(lc,lr,i)) * dsvar
              d(lc,lr,i) =
     &          (ms(lc)*ms(lr)*c1(lc,lr,i)+ns(lc)*ns(lr)*c6(lc,lr,i)+
     &           (ms(lc)*ns(lr)+ms(lr)*ns(lc))*c2(lc,lr,i)) * dsvar
              d(lr,lc,i) = d(lc,lr,i)
              f(lc,lr,i) = e(lr,lc,i)
              f(lr,lc,i) = e(lc,lr,i)
              h(lc,lr,i) = g(lr,lc,i)
              h(lr,lc,i) = g(lc,lr,i)
              a(lc,lr,i) = c(lr,lc,i)
              a(lr,lc,i) = c(lc,lr,i)
            end do
          end do
C
C     MATRIX ELEMENTS AT CONDUCTING WALL BOUNDARY IN THE VACUUM.
C
          if (i .eq. niv) then
            do lc = 1,lmns
              do lr = 1,lmns
                c(lc,lr,niv) = 0.
                g(lc,lr,niv) = 0.
                bl(lc,lr,niv) = 0.
                b(lc,lr,niv) = 0.
                h(lc,lr,niv) = 0.
                a(lc,lr,niv) = 0.
              end do
            end do
            do lc = 1,lmns
              bl(lc,lc,niv) = -3.0
              b(lc,lc,niv) = -4.0
            end do
          end if
C
          if (LLHSPR .eq. 9) then
 1000       format (/'   LHSMAT:       A,C,D,E,F,G,H,BL,BU',/)
C
            write (iunit_16,1000)
Cpara 1000 FORMAT(/'   LHSMAT:       B,A,C,D,E,F,G,H,BL,BU',/)
Cpara      I = 0
Cpara      WRITE (16,1001)   B(1,1,0),B(1,2,0),B(2,1,0),B(2,2,0),I
Cpara      WRITE (16,1002)
 1001       format (1x,1p4e14.6,i6)
C
            write (iunit_16,1001) A(1,1,I), A(1,2,I), A(2,1,I), A(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001) C(1,1,I), C(1,2,I), C(2,1,I), C(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001) D(1,1,I), D(1,2,I), D(2,1,I), D(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001) E(1,1,I), E(1,2,I), E(2,1,I), E(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001) F(1,1,I), F(1,2,I), F(2,1,I), F(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001) G(1,1,I), G(1,2,I), G(2,1,I), G(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001) H(1,1,I), H(1,2,I), H(2,1,I), H(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            BL(1,1,I), BL(1,2,I), BL(2,1,I), BL(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            BU(1,1,I), BU(1,2,I), BU(2,1,I), BU(2,2,I), I
C
C--sh-000831 400  continue
 1002       format (/)
            write (iunit_16,1002)
          end if
        else
C
C     MATRIX ELEMENTS AT THE INNERMOST FLUX SURFACE
          if (i .eq. 1) then
C      SI = (I-.5) * DS
C
            T1 = FPP(I)*CJ(I) - FTP(I)*CI(I)
            T2 = FPP(I)*FTPP(I) - FTP(I)*FPPP(I)
            T4 = CJ(I)*FPPP(I) - CI(I)*FTPP(I)
            T5 = T1 / SI
            GBTS = TDSS * T1
C
            do LC = 1,LMNS
C
              SIIC = 0.5 * dsvar / SI**QL(LC)
              PMN = MS(LC)*FPP(I) - NS(LC)*FTP(I)

write (iunit_24) s(ni:ni+ivac),ftp(ni+1),fpp(ni+1),walf
      write (iunit_24) ms(1:lmns),ns(1:lmns)
      write (iunit_24) c1(:,:,ni+1:ni+ivac),c2(:,:,ni+1:ni+ivac),
     &                 c3(:,:,ni+1:ni+ivac),c4(:,:,ni+1:ni+ivac),
     &                 c5(:,:,ni+1:ni+ivac),c6(:,:,ni+1:ni+ivac)
      end subroutine vacdump
C----------------------------------------------------------------------C
C  21.07.88          LAST MODIFICATION 14.07.16   UHS:  FOURIN  DATA D
C----------------------------------------------------------------------C
C
      subroutine FOURIN(ni,ivac,njk,lmns,lss,nper,mmaxdf,nmaxdf,llhspr,
     &                  lssd,lssl,dtdp,cospar,cospr2,s,ftp,fpp,ftpp,fppp
     &                 ,ci,cj,cip,cjp,pp,ql,ms,ns,lsx,bjac,bjacs,gssu,
     &                  sigbs,gparp,gperp,sigmab,taub,pphotj,parjp,
     &                parkur,gssl,gstl,gspl,gttl,gtpl,gppl,tss,tsc,C0,C1
     &                 ,C2,C3,C4,C5,C6,C7,c8,c9,c10,c11,cna,cnb,modelk)
C
C----------------------------------------------------------------------C
C     COMPUTE FOURIER INTEGRALS FOR LHS MATRIX ELEMENTS
C     AND RHS MATRIX ELEMENTS WITH FULL KINETIC ENERGY
C----------------------------------------------------------------------C
C
C
C.. Implicits ..
      USE tpr_param, ONLY: iunit_16
      implicit none
C
C.. Formal Arguments ..
      integer njk,lssd,lssl,lmns,ni,ivac,lss,nper,llhspr,ms(*),ns(*),
     &       mmaxdf,nmaxdf,lsx(-mmaxdf:mmaxdf,-nmaxdf:nmaxdf,0:1),modelk
!     &        lsx(-55:263,-42:42,0:1),modelk
!     &        lsx(-36:72,-42:42,0:1),modelk
      real dtdp,cospar,cospr2,s(0:*),ftp(*),fpp(*),ftpp(*),fppp(*),
     &     ci(*),cj(*),cip(*),cjp(*),pp(*),ql(*),bjac(njk,0:*),
     &     bjacs(njk,0:*),gssu(njk,0:*),sigbs(njk,0:*),gssl(njk,0:*),
     &     gstl(njk,0:*),gspl(njk,0:*),gttl(njk,0:*),gtpl(njk,0:*),
     &     gppl(njk,0:*),tss(lssd,*),tsc(max(lssl,lssd),*),
     &     c0(lmns,lmns,*),c1(lmns,lmns,*),c2(lmns,lmns,*),
     &     c3(lmns,lmns,*),c4(lmns,lmns,*),c5(lmns,lmns,*),
     &     c6(lmns,lmns,*),c7(lmns,lmns,*),c8(lmns,lmns,*),
     &     c9(lmns,lmns,*),cna(6,0:*),cnb(6,0:*)
!      real, dimension(NJK) :: A0  ,A1  ,A2  ,A3  ,A4  ,A5  ,A6  ,A7
      real, dimension(NJK,NI) :: GPARP ,GPERP ,SIGMAB ,TAUB ,PPHOTJ ,
     &                           PARJP ,PARKUR
      real, dimension(lmns,lmns,ni) :: C10, C11
      real, dimension(:), allocatable :: A0, A1 , A2 , A3 , A4 , A5, A6,
     &                                   A7, A8 , A10, A11

C
C.. Local Scalars ..
      integer I,jk,lc,ld,lmd,lmp,lp,lr,ndd,ndp,niv,npr,nprocs
      real PMN,RMN,SI,T0,T2,T3,T4,T8
      REAL :: SIGTAU ,PGRADT  ,GSPLM  ,SQGBSQ
C
C.. Intrinsic Functions ..
      intrinsic ABS, MIN, mod
C
C ... Executable Statements ...
C
 1000 format (/,'   FOURIN',i5,/)
C
      allocate( A0(NJK), A1(NJK), A2(NJK), A3(NJK) , A4(NJK) ,A5(NJK) ,
     &          A6(NJK), A7(NJK), A8(NJK), A10(NJK), A11(NJK))
!      allocate( C11(LMNS,LMNS,NI))
      write (iunit_16,1000) LMNS
C
      npr = 1
      nprocs = 1
      niv = ni + ivac
      do I = NPR,NIV,NPROCS
C
C--sh-000831      lmns4 = 4*lmns
        if (i .gt. ni) then
!
!...IN PSEUDOPLASMA VACUUM DOMAIN
C
C     THE COEFFICIENTS IN THE PSEUDO-VACUUM
C
C     COMPUTE FOURIER INTEGRALS OVER NSTA EQUILIBRIUM PERIODS
C
          do lr = 0,lss
            cna(1,lr) = 0.
            cna(2,lr) = 0.
            cna(3,lr) = 0.
            cnb(1,lr) = 0.
            cnb(2,lr) = 0.
            cnb(3,lr) = 0.
          end do
C
C--sh-000831      lmns3 = 3*lmns
C      do 540 lc  = 1,lss
C      do 540 nst = 1,nsta
C      do 540 jk  = 1,njk
C      jks = (nst-1)*njk + jk
C      flga(lc,1,jks) = gppl(jk,i) * tss(jks,lc)
C      flga(lc,2,jks) = gtpl(jk,i) * tss(jks,lc)
C      flga(lc,3,jks) = gttl(jk,i) * tss(jks,lc)
C      flga(lc,4,jks) = 0.
C 540  continue
C
C      call mxm(flga,lmns4,tss,njks,cna,lmns)
C
C
          do jk = 1,njk
            do lr = 1,lss
              cna(1,lr) = cna(1,lr) + gppl(jk,i)*tsc(lr,jk)
              cna(2,lr) = cna(2,lr) + gtpl(jk,i)*tsc(lr,jk)
              cna(3,lr) = cna(3,lr) + gttl(jk,i)*tsc(lr,jk)
            end do
          end do
C
C      do 545 lc  = 1,lmns
C      do 545 nst = 1,nsta
C      do 545 jk  = 1,njk
C      jks = (nst-1)*njk + jk
C      flga(lc,1,jks) = gstl(jk,i) * tss(jks,lc)
C      flga(lc,2,jks) = gssl(jk,i) * tsc(jks,lc)
C      flga(lc,3,jks) = gssu(jk,i) * tss(jks,lc)
C      flga(lc,4,jks) = 0.
C 545  continue
C
C      call mxm(flga,lmns4,tsc,njks,cnb,lmns)
C
          do jk = 1,njk
            do lr = 1,lss
              cnb(1,lr) = cnb(1,lr) + gstl(jk,i)*tss(lr,jk)
              cnb(2,lr) = cnb(2,lr) + gssl(jk,i)*tsc(lr,jk)
              cnb(3,lr) = cnb(3,lr) + gssu(jk,i)*tss(lr,jk)
            end do
          end do
C
C..MAP CNA AND CNB INTO THE C0, C1, C2, etc.
C
          do lc = 1,lmns
            do lr = 1,lmns
              lmd = MIN(1,ABS(mod(ns(lc)-ns(lr),nper)))
              lmp = MIN(1,ABS(mod(ns(lc)+ns(lr),nper)))
              ndd = (ns(lc)-ns(lr)) / nper
              ndp = (ns(lc)+ns(lr)) / nper
              ld = lsx(ms(lc)-ms(lr),ndd,lmd)
              lp = lsx(ms(lc)+ms(lr),ndp,lmp)
              c1(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cna(1,ld)-cospar*cna(1,lp))
              c2(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cna(2,ld)-cospar*cna(2,lp))
              c6(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cna(3,ld)-cospar*cna(3,lp))
C
              c4(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cnb(1,ld)+cospar*cnb(1,lp))
              c3(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cnb(2,ld)+cospar*cnb(2,lp))
              c5(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cnb(3,ld)+cospar*cnb(3,lp))
            end do
          end do
C
          if (LLHSPR .eq. 9) then
C--sh-000831  300 CONTINUE
 1001       format (1x,1p4e14.6,i6)
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            C1(1,1,I), C1(1,2,I), C1(2,1,I), C1(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            C2(1,1,I), C2(1,2,I), C2(2,1,I), C2(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            C3(1,1,I), C3(1,2,I), C3(2,1,I), C3(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            C4(1,1,I), C4(1,2,I), C4(2,1,I), C4(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            C5(1,1,I), C5(1,2,I), C5(2,1,I), C5(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            C6(1,1,I), C6(1,2,I), C6(2,1,I), C6(2,2,I), I
 1002       format (//)
            write (iunit_16,1002)
          end if
        else
!
!...IN PLASMA DOMAIN
!
C      SI = (I-.5) * DS
          SI = 0.5 * (s(i)+s(i-1))
          T0 = FPP(I) * FTPP(I) - FTP(I) * FPPP(I)
          SQGBSQ = CJ(I)*FPP(I) - CI(I)*FTP(I)
          T2 = T0 / SQGBSQ
          T3 = T0 * T0 / SQGBSQ
          T4 = (CJ(I) * FPPP(I) - CI(I) * FTPP(I)) / SQGBSQ
          T8 = CJ(I)*FPPP(I)-CI(I)*FTPP(I)+CJP(I)*FPP(I)-CIP(I)*FTP(I)
!...   INITIALISE
      DO JK=1,NJK
         A0 (JK) = 0.
         A1 (JK) = 0.
         A2 (JK) = 0.
         A3 (JK) = 0.
         A4 (JK) = 0.
         A5 (JK) = 0.
         A6 (JK) = 0.
         A7 (JK) = 0.
         A8 (JK) = 0.
         A10(JK) = 0.
         A11(JK) = 0.
      END DO
!
!...  FUNCTIONS REQUIRED TO BE EVALUATED FOR FULLY INTERACTING KO MODEL
!...  NOTE THAT GSPLM CAN BE FROM EITHER MAGNETIC OR GEOMETRIC CONSTRUCTION OF B_s
!
      IF (MODELK == 1) THEN      ! KO MODEL WITH REDUCED KINETIC ENERGY
       DO JK=1,NJK
         SIGTAU = SIGMAB(JK,I) / TAUB(JK,I)
         GSPLM = (SIGBS(JK,I) / SIGMAB(JK,I) -FPP(I)*GSTL(JK,I)) /FTP(I)
         PGRADT = BJAC(JK,I) * PP(I) * (1. + SIGTAU) + GPARP(JK,I)
     &           + SIGTAU * GPERP(JK,I)
         A0(JK) = 1.0 / SIGTAU
         A1(JK) = SIGBS(JK,I) / SIGTAU
         A2(JK) = PP(I) * BJAC(JK,I) + GPERP(JK,I)
         A3(JK) = SIGMAB(JK,I) * GSSL(JK,I)
     &           - (1.-1./SIGTAU) * SIGBS(JK,I) * SIGBS(JK,I) / SQGBSQ
         A4(JK) = SIGMAB(JK,I) * (CI(I) * GSTL(JK,I) + CJ(I) * GSPLM)
         A5(JK) = PARKUR(JK,I)
         A6(JK) = GSSU(JK,I)
         A7(JK) = 1./(1.+SIGTAU) * PGRADT * BJACS(JK,I)
     &          - (1./(1.+SIGTAU) * (GPARP(JK,I) - GPERP(JK,I)) *
     &            (PGRADT + T8)  + SIGBS(JK,I) * PPHOTJ(JK,I)) / SQGBSQ
       END DO
      ELSE IF (MODELK == 0) THEN   ! NI MODEL WITH REDUCED KINETIC ENERGY
       DO JK=1,NJK
         GSPLM = (SIGBS(JK,I) / SIGMAB(JK,I) -FPP(I)*GSTL(JK,I)) /FTP(I)
         A0(JK) = 1.0 / SIGMAB(JK,I)
         A1(JK) = SIGBS(JK,I) / SIGMAB(JK,I)
         A2(JK) = PP(I) * BJAC(JK,I)
         A3(JK) = GSSL(JK,I)
         A4(JK) = CI(I) * GSTL(JK,I) + CJ(I) * GSPLM
         A5(JK) = PARJP(JK,I)
         A6(JK) = GSSU(JK,I) / SIGMAB(JK,I)
         A7(JK) = PP(I) * BJAC(JK,I) * BJACS(JK,I)
       END DO
      ELSE IF (MODELK == 3) THEN    ! KO MODEL WITH PHYSICAL KINETIC ENERGY
       DO JK=1,NJK
         SIGTAU = SIGMAB(JK,I) / TAUB(JK,I)
         GSPLM = (SIGBS(JK,I) / SIGMAB(JK,I) -FPP(I)*GSTL(JK,I)) /FTP(I)
         PGRADT = BJAC(JK,I) * PP(I) * (1. + SIGTAU) + GPARP(JK,I)
     &           + SIGTAU * GPERP(JK,I)
         A0(JK) = 1.0 / SIGTAU
         A1(JK) = SIGBS(JK,I) / SIGTAU
         A2(JK) = PP(I) * BJAC(JK,I) + GPERP(JK,I)
         A3(JK) = SIGMAB(JK,I) * GSSL(JK,I)
     &           - (1.-1./SIGTAU) * SIGBS(JK,I) * SIGBS(JK,I) / SQGBSQ
         A4(JK) = SIGMAB(JK,I) * (CI(I) * GSTL(JK,I) + CJ(I) * GSPLM)
         A5(JK) = PARKUR(JK,I)
         A6(JK) = GSSU(JK,I)
         A7(JK) = 1./(1.+SIGTAU) * PGRADT * BJACS(JK,I)
     &          - (1./(1.+SIGTAU) * (GPARP(JK,I) - GPERP(JK,I)) *
     &            (PGRADT + T8)  + SIGBS(JK,I) * PPHOTJ(JK,I)) / SQGBSQ
         A8(JK) = BJAC(JK,I) * BJAC(JK,I) * GSSL(JK,I)
         A10(JK) = BJAC(JK,I) * BJAC(JK,I) * A6(JK) / SQGBSQ
         A11(JK)= - BJAC(JK,I) * BJAC(JK,I) *
     &            (CI(I) * GSTL(JK,I) + CJ(I) * GSPL(JK,I)) / SQGBSQ
!     &            (CI(I) * GSTL(JK,I) + CJ(I) * GSPLM) / SQGBSQ
       END DO
      ELSE IF (MODELK == 2) THEN    ! NI MODEL WITH PHYSICAL KINETIC ENERGY
       DO JK=1,NJK
         GSPLM = (SIGBS(JK,I) / SIGMAB(JK,I) -FPP(I)*GSTL(JK,I)) /FTP(I)
         A0(JK) = 1.0 / SIGMAB(JK,I)
         A1(JK) = SIGBS(JK,I) / SIGMAB(JK,I)
         A2(JK) = PP(I) * BJAC(JK,I)
         A3(JK) = GSSL(JK,I)
         A4(JK) = CI(I) * GSTL(JK,I) + CJ(I) * GSPLM
         A5(JK) = PARJP(JK,I)
         A6(JK) = GSSU(JK,I) / SIGMAB(JK,I)
         A7(JK) = PP(I) * BJAC(JK,I) * BJACS(JK,I)
         A8(JK) = BJAC(JK,I) * BJAC(JK,I) * GSSL(JK,I)
         A10(JK) = BJAC(JK,I) * BJAC(JK,I) * A6(JK) / SQGBSQ
         A11(JK)= - BJAC(JK,I) * BJAC(JK,I) *
     &            (CI(I) * GSTL(JK,I) + CJ(I) * GSPL(JK,I)) / SQGBSQ
!     &            (CI(I) * GSTL(JK,I) + CJ(I) * GSPLM) / SQGBSQ
       END DO
      END IF
C
C     COMPUTE FOURIER INTEGRALS OVER NSTA EQUILIBRIUM PERIODS
C
          do lr = 0,lss
            cna(1,lr) = 0.
            cna(2,lr) = 0.
            cna(3,lr) = 0.
            cna(4,lr) = 0
            cna(5,lr) = 0.
            cna(6,lr) = 0.
            cnb(1,lr) = 0.
            cnb(2,lr) = 0.
            cnb(3,lr) = 0.
            cnb(4,lr) = 0.
            cnb(5,lr) = 0.
            cnb(6,lr) = 0.
          end do
C
C      do 240 lc  = 1,lmns
C      do 240 nst = 1,nsta
C      do 240 jk  = 1,njk
C      jks = (nst-1)*njk + jk
C      flga(lc,1,jks) = bjac (jk,i) * tss(jks,lc)
C      flga(lc,2,jks) = gssu (jk,i) * tss(jks,lc)
C      flga(lc,3,jks) = bjacs(jk,i) * tss(jks,lc)
C      flga(lc,4,jks) = 0.
C 240  continue
C
C      call mxm(flga,lmns4,tss,njks,cna,lmns)
C
Cmxm      do 242 lc=1,lmns
          do jk = 1,njk
            do lr = 1,lss
              cna(1,lr) = cna(1,lr) + a2(jk)*tsc(lr,jk)
              cna(2,lr) = cna(2,lr) + a6(jk)*tsc(lr,jk)
              cna(3,lr) = cna(3,lr) + a7(jk)*tsc(lr,jk)
              cna(4,lr) = cna(4,lr) + a5(jk)*tsc(lr,jk)
              cna(5,lr) = cna(5,lr) + bjac(jk,i)*tsc(lr,jk)
              cna(6,lr) = cna(6,lr) + a0(jk)*tsc(lr,jk)
            end do
          end do
C
C      do 245 lc  = 1,lmns
C      do 245 nst = 1,nsta
C      do 245 jk  = 1,njk
C      jks = (nst-1)*njk + jk
C      flga(lc,1,jks) = sigbs(jk,i) * tss(jks,lc)
C      flga(lc,2,jks) = gssl (jk,i) * tsc(jks,lc)
C      flga(lc,3,jks) = gstl (jk,i) * tss(jks,lc)
C      flga(lc,4,jks) = bjac (jk,i) * tsc(jks,lc)
C 245  continue
C
C      call mxm(flga,lmns4,tsc,njks,cnb,lmns)
C
Cmxm      do 246 lc=1,lmns
          do jk = 1,njk
            do lr = 1,lss
              cnb(1,lr) = cnb(1,lr) + a1(jk)*tss(lr,jk)
              cnb(3,lr) = cnb(3,lr) + a4(jk)*tss(lr,jk)
              cnb(4,lr) = cnb(4,lr) + a10(jk)*tss(lr,jk)
              cnb(2,lr) = cnb(2,lr) + a3(jk)*tsc(lr,jk)
              cnb(5,lr) = cnb(5,lr) + a8(jk)*tsc(lr,jk)
              cnb(6,lr) = cnb(6,lr) + a11(jk)*tsc(lr,jk)
            end do
          end do
C
C..MAP CNA AND CNB INTO THE C0, C1, C2, etc.
C..   C8,  C10 AND C11 ARE THE COEFFICIENTS FIR THE NEAR PHYSICAL KINETIC ENERGY
C
          IF (MODELK > 1) THEN           !  PHYSICAL KINETIC ENERGY LOOPS
          do lc = 1,lmns
            do lr = 1,lmns
              lmd = MIN(1,ABS(mod(ns(lc)-ns(lr),nper)))
              lmp = MIN(1,ABS(mod(ns(lc)+ns(lr),nper)))
              ndd = (ns(lc)-ns(lr)) / nper
              ndp = (ns(lc)+ns(lr)) / nper
              ld = lsx(ms(lc)-ms(lr),ndd,lmd)
              lp = lsx(ms(lc)+ms(lr),ndp,lmp)
!              c0(lc,lr,i) = 0.
              c2(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cna(1,ld)-cospar*cna(1,lp))
              c6(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cna(2,ld)-cospar*cna(2,lp))
              c7(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cna(3,ld)-cospar*cna(3,lp))
              c5(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cna(4,ld)-cospar*cna(4,lp))
              c0(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cna(6,ld)-cospar*cna(6,lp))
C
              c1(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cnb(1,ld)+cospar*cnb(1,lp))
              c3(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cnb(2,ld)+cospar*cnb(2,lp))
              c4(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cnb(3,ld)+cospar*cnb(3,lp))
!              c8(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cna(5,ld)-cospar*cna(5,lp))
              c8(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cnb(5,ld)-cospar*cnb(5,lp))
              c10(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cnb(4,ld)+cospar*cnb(4,lp))
              c11(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cnb(6,ld)+cospar*cnb(6,lp))

!              c10(lc,lr,i) =
!     &         (c8(lc,lr,i)+dtdp*cospr2*cna(5,lp)) / (4.*ftp(i)*ftp(i))
            end do
          end do
         ELSE                      !REDUCED MODEL KINETIC ENERGY LOOPS
          do lc = 1,lmns
            do lr = 1,lmns
              lmd = MIN(1,ABS(mod(ns(lc)-ns(lr),nper)))
              lmp = MIN(1,ABS(mod(ns(lc)+ns(lr),nper)))
              ndd = (ns(lc)-ns(lr)) / nper
              ndp = (ns(lc)+ns(lr)) / nper
              ld = lsx(ms(lc)-ms(lr),ndd,lmd)
              lp = lsx(ms(lc)+ms(lr),ndp,lmp)
!              c0(lc,lr,i) = 0.
              c2(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cna(1,ld)-cospar*cna(1,lp))
              c6(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cna(2,ld)-cospar*cna(2,lp))
              c7(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cna(3,ld)-cospar*cna(3,lp))
              c5(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cna(4,ld)-cospar*cna(4,lp))
              c0(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cna(6,ld)-cospar*cna(6,lp))
C
              c1(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cnb(1,ld)+cospar*cnb(1,lp))
              c3(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cnb(2,ld)+cospar*cnb(2,lp))
              c4(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cnb(3,ld)+cospar*cnb(3,lp))
              c8(lc,lr,i) = dtdp * (cna(5,ld)-cospar*cna(5,lp))
              c11(lc,lr,i) = 0.

              c10(lc,lr,i) =
     &         (c8(lc,lr,i)+dtdp*cospr2*cna(5,lp)) / (4.*ftp(i)*ftp(i))
            end do
          end do
         ENDIF
C
C
!          do LC = 1,LMNS
!            C0(LC,LC,I) = 1.
!          end do
C
          do Lr = 1,LMNS
            RMN = MS(LR)*FPP(I) - NS(LR)*FTP(I)
C
            do LC = 1,LMNS
              PMN = MS(LC)*FPP(I) - NS(LC)*FTP(I)
C
              C9(LC,LR,I) = C7(LC,LR,I) + T0 * C5(LC,LR,I)
     &                     + T3 * C6(LC,LR,I)
     &        + (T4-QL(LC)/SI)*(T4-QL(LR)/SI)*SQGBSQ * C0(LC,LR,I)
     &                     + (T4 - (QL(LC)+QL(LR))/SI) * C2(LC,LR,I)
     &                     + PMN * RMN * C3(LC,LR,I)
     &        - RMN * (T2 * C4(LC,LR,I) + (T4 - QL(LC)/SI) *C1(LC,LR,I))
     &        - PMN * (T2 * C4(LR,LC,I) + (T4 - QL(LR)/SI) *C1(LR,LC,I))
            end do
C
          end do
C
          if (LLHSPR .eq. 9) then
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            C0(1,1,I), C0(1,2,I), C0(2,1,I), C0(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            C1(1,1,I), C1(1,2,I), C1(2,1,I), C1(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            C2(1,1,I), C2(1,2,I), C2(2,1,I), C2(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            C3(1,1,I), C3(1,2,I), C3(2,1,I), C3(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            C4(1,1,I), C4(1,2,I), C4(2,1,I), C4(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            C5(1,1,I), C5(1,2,I), C5(2,1,I), C5(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            C6(1,1,I), C6(1,2,I), C6(2,1,I), C6(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            C7(1,1,I), C7(1,2,I), C7(2,1,I), C7(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            C8(1,1,I), C8(1,2,I), C8(2,1,I), C8(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            C9(1,1,I), C9(1,2,I), C9(2,1,I), C9(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1002)
          end if
        end if
      end do
      deallocate (A0, A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8,  A10,  A11)
      end subroutine fourin

      subroutine RHSMAT(ni,ivac,lmns,lrhspr,s,ql,c8,c10,c11,ba,bb,bc,bd,

      subroutine VACMET(ivac,ni,njk,nowall,lmeshv,dsvac,pvac,qvac,dtdp,
     &                  alpha,s,vp,ftp,fpp,tor,bjac,gttl,gtpl,gppl,gssu,

C
C-----------------------------------------------------------------------
C
C     CALCULATE THE LOWER METRIC ELEMENTS DIVIDED BY THE JACOBIAN IN
C     THE PSEUDO-VACUUM.
C
Chelt      parameter (njkloc=2880)
Cl1t     parameter (njkloc=4320)
C--sh+000719>>>>>>>>>>
C
C.. Implicits ..
      USE tpr_param, ONLY: iunit_16, lscreen_trp, lrun_error
      implicit none
C
C.. Parameters ..
      real huge
      parameter (huge = 1e300)
C
C.. Formal Arguments ..
      integer njk,ivac,ni,nowall,lmeshv
      real dsvac,pvac,qvac,dtdp,alpha,s(0:*),vp(*),ftp(*),fpp(*),tor(*),
     &     bjac(njk,0:*),gttl(njk,0:*),gtpl(njk,0:*),gppl(njk,0:*),
     &     gssu(njk,0:*),gstl(njk,0:*),gssl(njk,0:*),rpvi(*),vpvi(*),
     &     zpvi(*),rtpvi(*),vtpvi(*),ztpvi(*),rppvi(*),vppvi(*),
     &     zppvi(*),rspvi(*),vspvi(*),zspvi(*),rstpvi(*),vstpvi(*),
     &     zstpvi(*),rsppvi(*),vsppvi(*),zsppvi(*),rwall(*),zwall(*),
     &     rtwall(*),ztwall(*),rpwall(*)
      real zpwall(*),rvac(*)
C
C.. Local Scalars ..
      integer i,jk,nwalt
      real alphsq,bjacmx,dsvds,rkinv,rpvac,rsvac,rtvac,rvmin,svac0,
     &     svac1,svac2,svac3,svac4,svac5,svac6,svach,vpvac,vpwall,vsvac,
     &     vtvac,vtwall,vwall,xys,xyt,zpvac,zsvac,ztvac,zvac
C
C
C.. Intrinsic Functions ..
!      real cvmgp
!      intrinsic cvmgp
      intrinsic ABS, MAX, MIN, merge
C
C ... Executable Statements ...
C
C
      dsvds = 1.0
C
      do i = 1,ivac
C      svach = 1. + dsvac * ((i - 0.5) / max0(ivac,1))**lmeshv
        nwalt = ABS(nowall)
        svach = 0.5 * (s(i+ni)+s(i+ni-1))
        svac0 = svach - 1.
        svac1 = 1. - nwalt*(svac0/dsvac)**pvac
        svac2 = svac0 * (1.-nwalt*(svac0/dsvac)**(pvac-1.)) / dsvds
        svac3 = nwalt * (svac0/dsvac)**qvac
        svac4 = -nwalt*pvac/dsvac*(svac0/dsvac)**(pvac-1.)
        svac5 = (1.-nwalt*pvac*(svac0/dsvac)**(pvac-1.)) / dsvds
        svac6 = nwalt * qvac / dsvac * (svac0/dsvac)**(qvac-1.)
        vp(ni+i) = 0.
C
C..TOROIDAL VACUUM REGION.
          do jk = 1,njk
            vwall = merge(tor(jk),vpvi(jk),nowall>=0)
            vpwall = merge(1.0,vppvi(jk),nowall>=0)
            vtwall = merge(0.0,vtpvi(jk),nowall>=0)
            rvac(jk) =
     &        svac1*rpvi(jk) + svac3*rwall(jk) + svac2*rspvi(jk)
            rsvac = svac4*rpvi(jk) + svac6*rwall(jk) + svac5*rspvi(jk)
            vsvac = svac4*vpvi(jk) + svac6*vwall + svac5*vspvi(jk)
            zsvac = svac4*zpvi(jk) + svac6*zwall(jk) + svac5*zspvi(jk)
            rtvac = svac1*rtpvi(jk) + svac3*rtwall(jk) +
     &              svac2*rstpvi(jk)
            vtvac = svac1*vtpvi(jk) + svac3*vtwall + svac2*vstpvi(jk)
            ztvac = svac1*ztpvi(jk) + svac3*ztwall(jk) +
     &              svac2*zstpvi(jk)
            rpvac = svac1*rppvi(jk) + svac3*rpwall(jk) +
     &              svac2*rsppvi(jk)
            vpvac = svac1*vppvi(jk) + svac3*vpwall + svac2*vsppvi(jk)
            zpvac = svac1*zppvi(jk) + svac3*zpwall(jk) +
     &              svac2*zsppvi(jk)
            bjac(jk,ni+i) =
     &        rvac(jk) *
     &        (rsvac*(vtvac*zpvac-vpvac*ztvac)+
     &         vsvac*(ztvac*rpvac-zpvac*rtvac)+
     &         zsvac*(rtvac*vpvac-rpvac*vtvac))
            vp(ni+i) = vp(ni+i) - bjac(jk,ni+i)
            gppl(jk,ni+i) =
     &        (rvac(jk)*rvac(jk)*vpvac*vpvac+rpvac*rpvac+zpvac*zpvac) /
     &        bjac(jk,ni+i)
            gtpl(jk,ni+i) =
     &        (rvac(jk)*rvac(jk)*vpvac*vtvac+rpvac*rtvac+zpvac*ztvac) /
     &        bjac(jk,ni+i)
            gttl(jk,ni+i) =
     &        (rvac(jk)*rvac(jk)*vtvac*vtvac+rtvac*rtvac+ztvac*ztvac) /
     &        bjac(jk,ni+i)
            gssu(jk,ni+i) =
     &        (rvac(jk)*rvac(jk)*vsvac*vpvac+rsvac*rpvac+zsvac*zpvac) /
     &        bjac(jk,ni+i)
            gstl(jk,ni+i) =
     &        (rvac(jk)*rvac(jk)*vsvac*vtvac+rsvac*rtvac+zsvac*ztvac) /
     &        bjac(jk,ni+i)
            gssl(jk,ni+i) =
     &        (rvac(jk)*rvac(jk)*vsvac*vsvac+rsvac*rsvac+zsvac*zsvac) /
     &        bjac(jk,ni+i)
          end do !
C
        ftp(ni+1) = 1.5*ftp(ni) - 0.5*ftp(ni-1)
        fpp(ni+1) = 1.5*fpp(ni) - 0.5*fpp(ni-1)
C
        vp(ni+i) = dtdp * vp(ni+i) * dsvds
C--sh-000719      rvmin = 1.e999
C--sh-000719      bjacmx=-1.e999
C--sh+000719>>>>>>>>>>
        rvmin = huge
        bjacmx = -huge
C--sh+000719<<<<<<<<<<
        do jk = 1,njk
          bjacmx = MAX(bjacmx,bjac(jk,ni+i))
          rvmin = MIN(rvmin,rvac(jk))
        end do
 200    format (11x,i4,3x,1p3e15.6)
        write (iunit_16,200) ni+i, vp(ni+i), bjacmx, rvmin
C      if (i.eq.4)
C     $write (16,250) bjac(jk,ni-1),bjac(jk,ni),bjac(jk,ni+1)
C     $,bjac(jk,ni+2),bjac(jk,ni+3),bjac(ni+4)
C 25   continue
C      endif
C 250  format (1p6e10.3)
C
        if (rvmin.lt.0.0.or.bjacmx.ge.0.) goto 1000
      end do
      return
 1000 if (rvmin .lt. 0.) then
 333    format (
     &  ' CONDUCTING WALL CROSSES MAJOR AXIS:  RVMIN =',1p1e12.4,
     &  'ON SURFACE =',i3)
        if (lscreen_trp) write (6,333) rvmin, i
      end if
      if (bjacmx .ge. 0.) then
 334    format (
     &  ' VACUUM PSEUDO-SURFACES INTERSECT:  BJACMX =',1p1e12.4,
     &  'ON SURFACE =',i3)
        if (lscreen_trp) write (6,334) bjacmx, i
      end if
      !stop
      lrun_error=.true.
      end subroutine VACMET
!
!      END BLOCK TPRGL3_BLOCK_AP

events.label: Reasoning block
events.text: **Planning exact array mapping implementation**

result.text:
niv = ni + ivac
      do i = npr,niv,nprocs
        T2DS = 2.0 / (s(i)-s(i-1))
        TDSS = T2DS * T2DS
        SI = 0.5 * (s(i)+s(i-1))
        dsvar = ni * (s(i)-s(i-1))
C
CPERF SCALE C0...C9 WITH DSTAN= 1./ (NPER/NSTA) * DS
C
CPERF DSTAN = 1. / (NPER/NSTA) * DS
C
        if (i .gt. ni) then
C
C     MATRIX ELEMENTS IN THE VACUUM REGION TREATED AS PSEUDOPLASMA.
C
C      sip = 1. + dsvac * (i - ni) / max0(ivac,1)
C      sim = 1. + dsvac * (i - ni - 1.)/max0(ivac,1)
C
          sip = s(i)
          sim = s(i-1)
          dsvar = ni * (sip-sim)
          tdsvac = 2. / (sip-sim)
          tdsvsq = tdsvac * tdsvac
          fppfpp = fpp(ni+1) * fpp(ni+1)
          ftpfpp = 2. * ftp(ni+1) * fpp(ni+1)
          ftpftp = ftp(ni+1) * ftp(ni+1)
          do lc = 1,lmns
            pmn = ms(lc)*fpp(ni+1) - ns(lc)*ftp(ni+1)
            do lr = lc,lmns
              rmn = ms(lr)*fpp(ni+1) - ns(lr)*ftp(ni+1)
              a(lc,lr,i) =
     &          tdsvsq *
     &          (fppfpp*c6(lc,lr,i)+ftpfpp*c2(lc,lr,i)+
     &           ftpftp*c1(lc,lr,i))
              f(lc,lr,i) =
     &          tdsvac * rmn *
     &          (fpp(ni+1)*c4(lc,lr,i)+ftp(ni+1)*c5(lc,lr,i))
              f(lr,lc,i) =
     &          tdsvac * pmn *
     &          (fpp(ni+1)*c4(lr,lc,i)+ftp(ni+1)*c5(lr,lc,i))
              h(lc,lr,i) = pmn * rmn * c3(lc,lr,i)
              bu(lc,lr,i) =
     &          0.25 * (a(lc,lr,i)+f(lc,lr,i)+f(lr,lc,i)+h(lc,lr,i)) *
     &          dsvar
              bl(lc,lr,i) =
     &          0.25 * (a(lc,lr,i)-f(lc,lr,i)-f(lr,lc,i)+h(lc,lr,i)) *
     &          dsvar
              c(lc,lr,i) =
     &          0.25 * (-a(lc,lr,i)+f(lc,lr,i)-f(lr,lc,i)+h(lc,lr,i)) *
     &          dsvar
              c(lr,lc,i) =
     &          0.25 * (-a(lc,lr,i)-f(lc,lr,i)+f(lr,lc,i)+h(lc,lr,i)) *
     &          dsvar
              f(lc,lr,i) =
     &          tdsvac *
     &          (ms(lr)*(fpp(ni+1)*c2(lc,lr,i)+ftp(ni+1)*c1(lc,lr,i))+
     &           ns(lr)*(fpp(ni+1)*c6(lc,lr,i)+ftp(ni+1)*c2(lc,lr,i)))
              f(lr,lc,i) =
     &          tdsvac *
     &          (ms(lc)*(fpp(ni+1)*c2(lc,lr,i)+ftp(ni+1)*c1(lc,lr,i))+
     &           ns(lc)*(fpp(ni+1)*c6(lc,lr,i)+ftp(ni+1)*c2(lc,lr,i)))
              h(lc,lr,i) = pmn * (ms(lr)*c5(lr,lc,i)+ns(lr)*c4(lr,lc,i))
              h(lr,lc,i) = rmn * (ms(lc)*c5(lc,lr,i)+ns(lc)*c4(lc,lr,i))
              e(lc,lr,i) = 0.5 * (f(lc,lr,i)+h(lc,lr,i)) * dsvar
              e(lr,lc,i) = 0.5 * (f(lr,lc,i)+h(lr,lc,i)) * dsvar
              g(lc,lr,i) = 0.5 * (-f(lr,lc,i)+h(lr,lc,i)) * dsvar
              g(lr,lc,i) = 0.5 * (-f(lc,lr,i)+h(lc,lr,i)) * dsvar
              d(lc,lr,i) =
     &          (ms(lc)*ms(lr)*c1(lc,lr,i)+ns(lc)*ns(lr)*c6(lc,lr,i)+
     &           (ms(lc)*ns(lr)+ms(lr)*ns(lc))*c2(lc,lr,i)) * dsvar
              d(lr,lc,i) = d(lc,lr,i)
              f(lc,lr,i) = e(lr,lc,i)
              f(lr,lc,i) = e(lc,lr,i)
              h(lc,lr,i) = g(lr,lc,i)
              h(lr,lc,i) = g(lc,lr,i)
              a(lc,lr,i) = c(lr,lc,i)
              a(lr,lc,i) = c(lc,lr,i)
            end do
          end do
C
C     MATRIX ELEMENTS AT CONDUCTING WALL BOUNDARY IN THE VACUUM.
C
          if (i .eq. niv) then
            do lc = 1,lmns
              do lr = 1,lmns
                c(lc,lr,niv) = 0.
                g(lc,lr,niv) = 0.
                bl(lc,lr,niv) = 0.
                b(lc,lr,niv) = 0.
                h(lc,lr,niv) = 0.
                a(lc,lr,niv) = 0.
              end do
            end do
            do lc = 1,lmns
              bl(lc,lc,niv) = -3.0
              b(lc,lc,niv) = -4.0
            end do
          end if
C
          if (LLHSPR .eq. 9) then
 1000       format (/'   LHSMAT:       A,C,D,E,F,G,H,BL,BU',/)
C
            write (iunit_16,1000)
Cpara 1000 FORMAT(/'   LHSMAT:       B,A,C,D,E,F,G,H,BL,BU',/)
Cpara      I = 0
Cpara      WRITE (16,1001)   B(1,1,0),B(1,2,0),B(2,1,0),B(2,2,0),I
Cpara      WRITE (16,1002)
 1001       format (1x,1p4e14.6,i6)
C
            write (iunit_16,1001) A(1,1,I), A(1,2,I), A(2,1,I), A(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001) C(1,1,I), C(1,2,I), C(2,1,I), C(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001) D(1,1,I), D(1,2,I), D(2,1,I), D(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001) E(1,1,I), E(1,2,I), E(2,1,I), E(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001) F(1,1,I), F(1,2,I), F(2,1,I), F(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001) G(1,1,I), G(1,2,I), G(2,1,I), G(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001) H(1,1,I), H(1,2,I), H(2,1,I), H(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            BL(1,1,I), BL(1,2,I), BL(2,1,I), BL(2,2,I), I
            write (iunit_16,1001)
     &            BU(1,1,I), BU(1,2,I), BU(2,1,I), BU(2,2,I), I
C
C
C--sh-000831 400  continue
 1002       format (/)
            write (iunit_16,1002)
          end if
        else
C
C     MATRIX ELEMENTS AT THE INNERMOST FLUX SURFACE
          if (i .eq. 1) then
C      SI = (I-.5) * DS
C
            T1 = FPP(I)*CJ(I) - FTP(I)*CI(I)
            T2 = FPP(I)*FTPP(I) - FTP(I)*FPPP(I)
            T4 = CJ(I)*FPPP(I) - CI(I)*FTPP(I)
            T5 = T1 / SI
            GBTS = TDSS * T1
C
            do LC = 1,LMNS
C
              SIIC = 0.5 * dsvar / SI**QL(LC)
              PMN = MS(LC)*FPP(I) - NS(LC)*FTP(I)
              CMN = MS(LC)*CI(I) - NS(LC)*CJ(I)
C      WRITE (16,*) LC,PMN,CMN
CPERF PMN = TPI * PMN
CPERF CMN = TPI * CMN
CPERF TPMC= TPI * MS(LC)
C      WRITE (16,*) LC,PMN,CMN
C
              do LR = LC,LMNS
C
                SIIR = 0.5 * dsvar / SI**QL(LR)
                SIIS = SIIC * SIIR / dsvar
                RMN = MS(LR)*FPP(I) - NS(LR)*FTP(I)
                DMN = MS(LR)*CI(I) - NS(LR)*CJ(I)
C
                A(LC,LR,I) =
     &            T2DS *
     &            (RMN*C1(LC,LR,I)+PMN*C1(LR,LC,I)-2.*C2(LC,LR,I)-
     &             (2.*T4-(QL(LC)+QL(LR))*T5)*C0(LC,LR,I))
                F(LC,LR,I) = GBTS * C0(LC,LR,I)
C
                B(LC,LR,I-1) = 0.
                Bl(LC,LR,I) = (F(LC,LR,I)-A(LC,LR,I)+C9(LC,LR,I)) * SIIS
Cpara      BL(LC,LR,I)  = B(LC,LR,I)
Cpara      BL(LR,LC,I)  = B(LC,LR,I)
                C(LC,LR,I) = 0.
                C(LR,LC,I) = 0.
C
                G(LC,LR,I) =
     &            SIIR *
     &            (+T2DS*CMN*C0(LC,LR,I) + (PMN *
     &             (RMN*C4(LC,LR,I) - T1*C5(LC,LR,I) - T2*C6(LC,LR,I))
     &           + CMN * (C2(LC,LR,I) - RMN * C1(LC,LR,I)
     &                      + (T4-QL(LR)*T5) * C0(LC,LR,I))) / T1)
!
                G(LR,LC,I) =
     &            SIIC *
     &            (+T2DS*DMN*C0(LC,LR,I) + (RMN *
     &             (PMN*C4(LR,LC,I) - T1*C5(LC,LR,I) - T2*C6(LC,LR,I))
     &           + DMN * (C2(LC,LR,I) - PMN * C1(LR,LC,I)
     &                      + (T4-QL(LC)*T5) * C0(LC,LR,I))) / T1)
!
C     WRITE (16,1003)SIIR * ( +T2DS * CMN * C0(LC,LR,I)),
C    >             SIIR*  CMN * (PP(I)*C2(LC,LR,I))/T1,
C    >           - SIIR*  CMN * (T4+QL(LR)*T5) * C0(LC,LR,I)/T1,
C    >           - SIIR * PMN * (C5(LC,LR,I)) /T1,
C    >           - SIIR * PMN * (C6(LC,LR,I)*T2)/T1,I
C      CT1(I) =       SIIR * ( +T2DS * CMN * C0(LC,LR,I))
C      CT2(I) =     SIIR*  CMN * (PP(I)*C2(LC,LR,I))/T1
C      CT3(I) =   - SIIR*  CMN * (T4+QL(LR)*T5) * C0(LC,LR,I)/T1
C      CT4(I) =   - SIIR * PMN * (C5(LC,LR,I)) /T1
C      CT5(I) =   - SIIR * PMN * (C6(LC,LR,I)*T2)/T1
C 1003 FORMAT(1X,1P5E15.6,I3)
C
                E(LR,LC,I) = 0.
                E(LC,LR,I) = 0.
                BU(LC,LR,I) = 0.
Cpara      BU(LR,LC,I)  = 0.
C
                D(LC,LR,I) =
     &            (PMN*RMN*C6(LC,LR,I)+CMN*DMN*C0(LC,LR,I)) / T1 * dsvar
C
C     FILL IN THE ELEMENTS BELOW THE DIAGONAL
C
                BU(LC,LC,I) = -1.0
                B(LR,LC,I-1) = 0.
                B(LC,LC,I-1) = -2.0
                D(LR,LC,I) = D(LC,LR,I)
C     WRITE (16,1009)LC,LR,D(LC,LR,I),PMN*RMN*C6(LC,LR,I)/T1,
C    $ CMN*DMN*C0(LC,LR,I)/T1,I
C 1009 FORMAT (2I2,1P3E15.6,I4)
                F(LC,LR,I) = 0.
                F(LR,LC,I) = 0.
                A(LC,LR,I) = 0.
                A(LR,LC,I) = 0.
                H(LC,LR,I) = G(LR,LC,I)
                H(LR,LC,I) = G(LC,LR,I)
              end do
C      WRITE (16,*) LC,PMN,CMN
CPERF PMN = TPI * PMN
CPERF CMN = TPI * CMN
CPERF TPMC= TPI * MS(LC)
C      WRITE (16,*) LC,PMN,CMN
C
            end do
          else
C     MATRIX ELEMENTS IN THE BULK PLASMA REGION
C
Cpara      DO 200 I = 2,NI-1
C
C      SI = (I-.5) * DS
            T1 = FPP(I)*CJ(I) - FTP(I)*CI(I)
            T2 = FPP(I)*FTPP(I) - FTP(I)*FPPP(I)
            T4 = CJ(I)*FPPP(I) - CI(I)*FTPP(I)
            T5 = T1 / SI
            GBTS = TDSS * T1
C
            do LC = 1,LMNS
C
              SIIC = 0.5 * dsvar / SI**QL(LC)
              PMN = MS(LC)*FPP(I) - NS(LC)*FTP(I)
              CMN = MS(LC)*CI(I) - NS(LC)*CJ(I)
C
              do LR = LC,LMNS
C
                SIIR = 0.5 * dsvar / SI**QL(LR)
                SIIS = SIIC * SIIR / dsvar
                RMN = MS(LR)*FPP(I) - NS(LR)*FTP(I)
                DMN = MS(LR)*CI(I) - NS(LR)*CJ(I)
C
                A(LC,LR,I) =
     &            T2DS *
     &            (RMN*C1(LC,LR,I)+PMN*C1(LR,LC,I)-2.*C2(LC,LR,I)-
     &             (2.*T4-(QL(LC)+QL(LR))*T5)*C0(LC,LR,I))
                F(LC,LR,I) = GBTS * C0(LC,LR,I)
C
                BU(LC,LR,I) = (F(LC,LR,I)+A(LC,LR,I)+C9(LC,LR,I)) * SIIS
Cpara      BU(LR,LC,I)  = BU(LC,LR,I)
Cpara      B(LC,LR,I-1) = B(LC,LR,I-1) + BU(LC,LR,I)
                Bl(LC,LR,I) = (F(LC,LR,I)-A(LC,LR,I)+C9(LC,LR,I)) * SIIS
Cpara      BL(LC,LR,I)  = B(LC,LR,I)
Cpara      BL(LR,LC,I)  = B(LC,LR,I)
                C(LC,LR,I) =
     &            SIIS *
     &            (-F(LC,LR,I)+C9(LC,LR,I)+
     &             T2DS*
     &             (RMN*C1(LC,LR,I)-PMN*C1(LR,LC,I)+
     &              (QL(LR)-QL(LC))*T5*C0(LC,LR,I)))
                C(LR,LC,I) =
     &            C(LC,LR,I) -
     &            2.*T2DS*SIIS*
     &            (RMN*C1(LC,LR,I)-PMN*C1(LR,LC,I)+
     &             (QL(LR)-QL(LC))*T5*C0(LC,LR,I))
C
                E(LC,LR,I) =
     &            SIIC *
     &            (-T2DS*DMN*C0(LC,LR,I) + (RMN *
     &             (PMN*C4(LR,LC,I) - T1*C5(LC,LR,I) - T2*C6(LC,LR,I))
     &           + DMN * (C2(LC,LR,I) - PMN * C1(LR,LC,I)
     &                      + (T4-QL(LC)*T5) * C0(LC,LR,I))) / T1)
C
                G(LC,LR,I) =
     &            SIIR *
     &            (+T2DS*CMN*C0(LC,LR,I) + (PMN *
     &             (RMN*C4(LC,LR,I) - T1*C5(LC,LR,I) - T2*C6(LC,LR,I))
     &           + CMN * (C2(LC,LR,I) - RMN * C1(LC,LR,I)
     &                      + (T4-QL(LR)*T5) * C0(LC,LR,I))) / T1)
C
                G(LR,LC,I) = E(LC,LR,I) + 2.*T2DS*SIIC*DMN*C0(LC,LR,I)
C     WRITE (16,1003)SIIR * ( +T2DS * CMN * C0(LC,LR,I)),
C    >             SIIR*  CMN * (PP(I)*C2(LC,LR,I))/T1,
C    >           - SIIR*  CMN * (T4+QL(LR)*T5) * C0(LC,LR,I)/T1,
C    >           - SIIR * PMN * (C5(LC,LR,I)) /T1,
C    >           - SIIR * PMN * (C6(LC,LR,I)*T2)/T1,I
C      CT1(I) =       SIIR * ( +T2DS * CMN * C0(LC,LR,I))
